title: Page — Privacy Policy

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: privacy_heading
fields.default_value: Clear, simple and built around your trip.

fields.label: Intro Text
fields.name: privacy_intro_text
fields.default_value: We only ask for details that help us manage your parking reservation, communicate with you about shuttle service and improve your customer experience.

default_value.title: Protected Booking Details
default_value.text: Used to confirm and support your reservation.

default_value.heading: 1. Information We Collect
default_value.text: When you reserve a parking spot, call us, email us or submit a form, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, vehicle make or model, plate number, parking dates, flight details and any message you choose to provide.

default_value.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
default_value.text: We use your information to confirm reservations, support check-in and pickup, provide shuttle coordination, answer customer service requests, improve our website and keep accurate business records.

default_value.heading: 3. Sharing Your Information
default_value.text: We do not sell your personal information. We may share limited information with trusted service providers when needed to operate the website, process communications or comply with legal obligations.

default_value.heading: 4. Cookies And Website Data
default_value.text: Our website may use cookies or similar tools to understand basic site activity, improve performance and make your browsing experience smoother. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

default_value.heading: 5. Data Security
default_value.text: We use reasonable administrative and technical measures to help protect your information. No online system is completely secure, but we work to keep customer data handled carefully and responsibly.

default_value.heading: 6. Your Choices
default_value.text: You may contact us to request an update, correction or deletion of your personal information, subject to any records we are required to keep for business or legal reasons.

default_value.heading: 7. Policy Updates
default_value.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page so you can review how we handle your information.

fields.label: Text
fields.name: privacy_sidebar_text
fields.default_value: Our team can help with privacy questions, reservation details or account information requests.
